Effective date: September 8, 2026
Last updated: September 8, 2026 (Version 1)

This privacy policy explains what data the Quadratum app collects, how it's used, and your rights regarding that data.

Data We Collect

During Gameplay (Multiplayer)

  • Player ID: Temporary unique identifier for your game session
  • Player Name: Your chosen nickname (may contain personal data if you use real names)
  • Game Session ID: Random identifier for the active game
  • IP Address: Used only to establish and secure the real-time connection
  • Realtime Messages: Game actions and moves synchronized between players

Stored Locally on Your Device

  • Player Name and Opponent Name (last used)
  • Game settings (difficulty, first move preferences)
  • Onboarding completion status
  • Legal document version (consented)
  • App review trigger status

How We Use Your Data

All data is used solely to:

  • Enable multiplayer gameplay functionality
  • Synchronize game state between players in real time
  • Store your preferences for convenience
  • Maintain game sessions

Data Retention

  • Session data: Automatically deleted within 24 hours after your game session ends
  • Local data: Stored on your device until you uninstall the app
  • No permanent storage: We do not permanently store any personal data

Data Sharing

  • Supabase (EU-based servers): Temporarily processes session data for real-time synchronization
  • No third-party sharing: We do not share data with any other third parties
  • No analytics or tracking: We use no analytics, tracking, or crash reporting tools

Your Rights (GDPR)

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Restrict processing of your data
  • Export your local data
  • Object to data processing
  • Withdraw consent

Note: Server-side data is automatically deleted within 24 hours. Local data can be deleted by uninstalling the app.

Additional Information

  • This app is not intended for children under 16 (EU/EEA) or 13 (other regions)
  • We do not knowingly collect data from children
  • All data processing occurs within the European Union
  • We follow the principle of data minimization - collecting only what's necessary for gameplay
